questions.text:
Given f(w,x,y,z) = [latex]\sum_{m}[/latex]
  (0,1,2,3,7,8,10) + [latex]\sum_{d}[/latex]
  (5,6,11,15), where d represents the don't care
condition in Karnaugh maps. Which of the following is a minimum product-of-sums (POS)
form of f(w,x,y,z) ?
questions.solution:
The zeros of f are minterms 4, 9, 12, 13, 14 (5, 6, 11, 15 are don't-cares).
- [latex](\bar w+\bar z)[/latex] is 0 when w = z = 1: covers 9, 13 (and don't-cares 11, 15)
- [latex](\bar x+z)[/latex] is 0 when x = 1, z = 0: covers 4, 12, 14 (and don't-care 6)

Together they cover every 0 and no 1.

Answer: [latex](\bar w+\bar z)(\bar x+z)[/latex]

questions.text: If w, x, y, z are Boolean variables, then which one of the following is INCORRECT ?
questions.solution:
Simplify the left side of option 3:
[latex](w\bar x(y+x\bar z)+\bar w\bar x)y=(w\bar xy+\bar w\bar x)y=w\bar xy+\bar w\bar xy=\bar xy[/latex]

This is [latex]\bar xy[/latex], not [latex]x\bar y[/latex], so option 3 is incorrect. The other three identities hold.

Answer: Option 3

questions.text:
Given the following binary number in 32-bit (single precision) IEEE-754 format:
00111110011011010000000000000000
The decimal value closest to this floating- point number is
questions.solution:
Sign 0; exponent 01111100 = 124 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [latex]2^{124-127}=2^{-3}[/latex]; mantissa 1.1101101[latex]{}_2[/latex] [latex]\approx[/latex] 1.85.

Value [latex]\approx1.85\times\frac18\approx0.23[/latex], closest to [latex]2.27\times10^{-1}[/latex].

Answer: [latex]2.27\times10^{-1}[/latex]

questions.text:
The representation of the value of a 16-bit unsigned integer X in hexadecimal number system
is BCA9. The representation of the value of X in octal number system is
questions.solution:
BCA9 in binary: 1011 1100 1010 1001. Regroup in 3s from the right: 1 011 110 010 101 001 = 1 3 6 2 5 1.

Answer: 136251

questions.text:
Consider a combination of T and D flip-flops connected as shown below. The output of the D flip-flop is connected to the input of the T flip-flop and the output of the T flip-flop is connected to the input of the D flip-flop

Initailly, both [latex]Q_{0}[/latex] and [latex]Q_{1}[/latex] are set to 1 (before the 1st clock cycle). The outputs
questions.solution:
T input = [latex]Q_0[/latex], D input = [latex]Q_1[/latex]. So [latex]Q_1^+=Q_1\oplus Q_0[/latex] and [latex]Q_0^+=Q_1[/latex]. Start [latex]Q_1Q_0[/latex] = 11:
- cycle 1: 01
- cycle 2: 10
- cycle 3: 11
- cycle 4: 01

Answer: 11 after the 3rd cycle and 01 after the 4th cycle
